newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Totta reviewing dividend policy - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Banco Totta reviewing dividend policy - analysts.

text.p: The Champalimaud group is reviewing the dividend policy adopted by its banks, particularly Banco Totta & Azores, which has traditionally been generous with its payout, analysts said on Wednesday.
Analysts who attended a presentation by the group said that they had been told that there was nothing to be gained by giving out very high dividends to shareholders.

"In the presentation, group officials said that there was no benefit to paying out a high dividend and that it would be better to leave it within the institution," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
But he said that the group gave no indication of what sort of dividend could be considered reasonable.
Banco Totta eased 2.7 percent at 2,422 escudos after having touched a low of 2,380 soon after the presentation on Wednesday morning.
